name: bash-lsp
description: Bash language server (bash-language-server) for code intelligence in .sh and .bash files - diagnostics (through shellcheck when it is on PATH), hover, definitions, references, symbols and completion. Registers an LSP server only: no hooks, commands, agents or skills. Needs Node.js 20 or newer and a global 'bash-language-server' install; the plugin does not install either.
